children: may extend loss into a range of $4,320-$4,351 per ounce, as suggested by its wave pattern and a Fibonacci projection analysis.
A five-wave cycle from the July 29 low of $3,995 has completed at the August 24 high of $4,696, as suggested by the deep fall from this high.

The bottom of the wave 4 at $4,324 is considered one of the targets. A projection analysis on the uptrend from $3,959 reveals the target zone of $4,320-$4,351, formed by the 138.2% and the 150% levels.
Another projection analysis on the fall from $4,630 marks a lower target range of $4,278-$4,310, formed by the 261.8% and the 238.2% levels.

Resistance is at $4,444, a break above which may trigger a gain into the $4,476-$4,495 range. On the daily chart, the fall from $4,696 looks so deep that it could hardly be classified as a pullback toward the falling trendline.
Instead, the fall might be either a deep correction toward $4,011-$3,945 range, where the trough of the wave b lies, or a continuation of the downtrend from $5,595.
